SyntaxDoc.description: SyntaxDoc is one statement, operator or test.

usage.description: Usage is how a template writes it.

description: FiltersTopic is `pleiades doc filters --json`: what a task parameter's {{ }} template may read and call, the whole closed set. Printed by pleiades doc filters --json. schema_version is the major version: it goes up only for a change an existing reader could misread, a field removed or renamed or given another type or meaning. Within a major version a newer producer may add fields, and new values to the open sets. So a reader ignores a field it does not know, treats a status or kind it does not know as not a pass, and refuses a major version it does not know.

excluded.description: Excluded are the Jinja2 filters left out on purpose, each with why.

filters.description: Filters are every filter a template may use, by name.

not_supported.description: NotSupported are the Jinja2 forms this renderer does not have, each with why.

operators.description: Operators are every operator, loosest first.

roots.description: Roots are the names a template may read.

schema_version.description: SchemaVersion is this document's major version, FiltersVersion.

statements.description: Statements are every statement a template may use.

tests.description: Tests are every test, written x is name or x is not name.
